verdict.rationale: Rippling's own identity page claims federated identity support covering OIDC and custom SAML apps, so off-catalog SSO for those protocols is a direct but thinly evidenced capability. Header-based app support and step-by-step configuration walkthroughs are not documented anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: header-based app SSO, documented custom-app configuration walkthroughs, depth on the custom OIDC/SAML setup flow, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an IT admin, apps outside the catalog still get SSO — custom SAML, OIDC, and header-based apps configured with documented walkthroughs

citations.quote: Federated identity lets you handle any protocol with ease—from LDAP, Active Directory (AD), OIDC, and RADIUS, to custom SCIM and SAML apps.
